assumptions: The clusters are the right states and the continuum runs through them; the tree over their centres is the path the cells take; the root is the true start.
limits: Slingshot's own clustering-free mode, its `predict` on new cells and a dimensionality reduction before it are not run here; the channels are taken as given.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which developmental paths run through these clusters, and how far along each path is every event?

description: Lineages and pseudotime on a project FCS file by Slingshot (slingshot 2.20.0): the clusters are either a clustering run here with the cluster_* knobs (as cluster_flow_cytometry_events runs it) or two or more of the strategy's populations (an event in two is left out); at most max_events events drawn by R's sample(); a minimum spanning tree over the cluster centres (Slingshot's covariance-scaled, Euclidean or Mahalanobis distance, optional outgroup), lineages from the root, and simultaneous principal curves shrunk toward their average.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

allow_breaks.description: let lineages that diverge early skip shrinkage there.

approx_points.description: curve points; -1 for Slingshot's default (150 over 150 events), 0 for every event.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

channels.description: source clustering: channels to cluster on, comma-separated; empty for every fluorescence channel.

cluster_source.description: the clusters: a clustering run here with the cluster_* knobs, or populations.

dbscan_eps.description: DBSCAN radius on the display scale.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

downsample.description: downsample before clustering: none, spade (density-dependent) or random; the rest take their nearest clustered event’s label.

downsample_exclude_percent.description: SPADE exclude_pctile, percent: the sparsest events dropped as noise.

downsample_percent.description: percent of events kept (SPADE: of those left after exclusion).

end_clus.description: comma-separated clusters forced to be lineage ends.

extend.description: how the initial curves extend past the end clusters.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

max_events.description: events drawn at most by R's sample() (0 keeps all).

mclust_model.description: mclust covariance model (modelNames): EII, VII spherical; EEI, VEI, EVI, VVI diagonal; EEE, VEE, EVE, VVE, EEV, VEV, EVV, VVV ellipsoidal; 'all' compares them by BIC.

mclust_start.description: mclust initial hierarchy: 'VVV' is mclust's default (hcModelName VVV, hcUse SVD), 'EII' the spherical Ward start on the raw channels (hcModelName EII, hcUse VARS).

omega.description: an outgroup cluster: off, at omega_scale × the median edge, or at omega_value.

omega_scale.description: the automatic outgroup multiple of the median edge.

pheno_iterations.description: Leiden n_iterations; negative iterates until stable.

plot_population.description: the population plotted; empty for all events.

plot_x.description: channel (PnN or PnS) on the density plot's x axis; empty for no plot.

plot_y.description: channel on the plot's y axis.

populations.description: source populations: the comma-separated populations taken as clusters (2 or more).

seed.description: R set.seed (k-means, PhenoGraph, SamSPECTRAL, mclust subset).

shrink.description: shrinkage toward the average curve, 0 to 1.

spade_apprx_mult.description: SPADE apprx_mult: events this close share a density count.

spade_kernel_mult.description: SPADE kernel_mult: density radius in median nearest-neighbour distances.

spade_med_samples.description: SPADE med_samples: events sampled for the median nearest-neighbour distance.

spectral_neighbors.description: spectral clustering n_neighbors (the event itself counted).

start_clus.description: the root cluster ('Cluster 3', or a population's name); empty lets Slingshot choose.

stretch.description: how far curve ends are extrapolated.

trajectory_channels.description: channels Slingshot runs in, comma-separated; empty for the clustered channels (every channel but time for populations).

xshift_nsize.description: X-shift neighbours searched for a denser parent; 0 is automatic.

name: fit_flow_cytometry_trajectory

curves.description: each lineage curve, its points in curve order, one value per channel

lineages.description: per lineage: its clusters in order, events on it, median and longest pseudotime

mst.description: the cluster tree: from, to, distance and gain per edge

pseudotime.description: per event used (0-based file index): its pseudotime and weight on every lineage (null off it)
